frozen_before: Any replay-order versus RUN-coordination-change association in this branch
scope: Measure a candidate RUN change endpoint and its out-of-fold rate-control diagnostics. This is not a calibrated association procedure or a validated replay cohort.
theta_support: Honor each frozen pause's theta screen; require finite phase on all frozen references at the endpoints actually measured. Keep invalid and zero-event pauses in the denominator.
rate_model: Separate PRE and POST empirical-Bayes Poisson rate models on joint position/direction/speed/LFP-phase strata. Each held-out five-second block is predicted without using its spike counts or counts within a 60-ms guard. Stratum estimates shrink toward that period's training-only global cell rates by 0.25 seconds. Zero-spike bins are retained. Report unseen-stratum fraction and held-out improvement versus the training-only global-rate baseline; neither is concealed by dropping bins.
coordination: Signed mean cross-product of out-of-fold Pearson residuals for A-before-B minus B-before-A at physical lags 5-60 ms. Only observed theta-valid endpoints contribute; omitted bins remain physical clock gaps rather than being concatenated. Save PRE, POST and POST-minus-PRE for every frozen unit pair.
preceding_coordination: Store the identical PRE coordination endpoint as the required preceding-coordination control for the future association model; do not fit that model in this stage.
inference_unit: Animal, not pairs. No inference or biological support flag is emitted by this development measurement.
claim_boundary: Discrete covariate adjustment is approximate and must survive the full null bank. No claim of synaptic connectivity, STDP, causation, Bayesian smoothing, independently validated replay or completed goal. PF remains untestable with the required theta control until its missing input is supplied.
